verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only automated AI-driven checks, such as website risk review, alert adjudication and auto-decisioning. It never mentions an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. These automated pipelines are adjacent features, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
